capabilities: : Conditionally render UI based on context
: Update UI across multiple notes simultaneously
disambiguation: It inject UI into rendered notes without modifying the underlying note content.
extras: Caution advised due to a bug where CodeMirror widgets randomly deletes empty lines.
motivation: People have been trying to add navigation to daily notes for as long as daily notes have existed. Countless solutions have emerged... Auto UI Injector takes a different approach: keep the UI out of your notes.
problem: Existing solutions for adding UI elements to notes often require modifying note content, leading to excessive scrolling and difficult bulk updates when changes are needed.
